protocol.scope: Exploratory analysis of the same historical development sample, not a new holdout.

model_config.trade_return_basis: signed realized excess return; roundtrip cost charged to each active event trade
model_config.interval_method: Empirical calibration residual quantiles; coverage is not guaranteed.
model_config.probability_method: Smoothed empirical fraction of calibration residuals producing a positive excess return.
model_config.portfolio_note: Event trade averages are not a capital-constrained portfolio backtest; no annualized Sharpe is estimated.

selection.status: Exploratory historical comparison; the existing sample has already been inspected.
selection.penalty_basis: Ridge/Huber coefficient penalty equals the candidate multiplier times fitting row count.
selection.huber_target_scale: 1.4826 times fitting-target median absolute deviation, floored at 1e-6.
selection.purging: Inner fitting labels must exit strictly before the first inner-validation decision date.
selection.scaling: Each candidate learns feature normalization on its inner fitting rows only.
selection.selection: Minimum inner-validation MAE; exact ties favor the earlier, simpler candidate.
selection.fallback: Zero excess return when inner sample minimums are not met.
selection.refit: The selected candidate is refit on the whole purged outer fit. Outer calibration and test rows are never selection inputs.

model_config.evaluation_scope: Exploratory historical development; these outcomes have already been inspected.

diagnostics.comparison_sign: baseline MAE minus model MAE; positive favors the model
diagnostics.bootstrap_note: Paired forecast errors share the same resampled holding-window blocks. Dependence between blocks and model development on this inspected sample are not accounted for.
diagnostics.slice_note: Every observed year, source and target is shown. Slices describe the same predictions without refitting; they are not independent tests or evidence of subgroup significance.

fixture.manifest_hash_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps with sort_keys=True; semantic JSON identity

protocol.implementation_scope: Source files on disk before and after the run; not an attestation of previously imported code.
protocol.confound_sensitivity: Same fitted forecasts, split by observed peer-disclosure overlap; no retraining. Missing events outside the six-company cache are not ruled out.
protocol.return_unit: decimal; multiply by 100 for percentage points

limits: Historical sample used during development, not an untouched holdout or a pre-registered study.
This numerical replay does not reconstruct raw source collection, text extraction, original release timestamps, or a point-in-time company universe.
Correction and selection comparisons use the same observations as the original reference, not independent replication.
All-company peer relationships are assumptions. Observed concurrent disclosure flags only cover filings present in the six-company source cache.
Empirical residual intervals have no distribution-free coverage guarantee; bootstrap intervals do not correct for study selection or remaining between-block dependence.
